page.overview:
Who is Emma Kliesen?

Emma worked for the Mishima Zaibatsu under Heihachi Mishima, and was a genetic research scientist involved in trying to create supersoldiers through genetic experimentation, in attempt to emulate the Devil Gene's power. The program used the genes and eggs of the then-cryogenically frozen Nina Williams to create babies to experiment on, Steve Fox being one of these. The research program continued for many years and involved the deaths of many children who failed in the early experimental process. Emma was the scientist in charge of observing Steve Fox (then known as Subject NT01) and grew attached to the boy. She came to see him as a human rather than just an experiment. She was admonished by her superiors for unprofessional emotional attachment and relocated. The supersoldier program was declared a failure, but Emma was still able to help Steve by declaring Subject NT01 dead at the age of 6 while, in reality, he had been transferred to an orphanage in the United Kingdom. Emma also helped Niklas fake his death to escape threats from the Zaibatsu on his life, maintaining contact with Niklas without Leo knowing.

An undisclosed amount of time after this, Emma left the Mishima Zaibatsu and joined G Corporation as an executive. Prior to the fourth tournament, she worked for Kazuya Mishima researching the Devil Gene. As she began to understand the threat the Devil Gene posed, Emma began researching weaknesses of the Devil Gene in a top-secret facility in Nepal. Before Emma could complete this research, however, Heihachi sent in Tekken Force to infiltrate both the Nepal and Nebraska facilities of G Corporation, stealing the data Emma had gathered and destroying the Nepal facility entirely. Kazuya, being held in the Nebraska facility, was able to single-handedly defend it from attack, causing higher-ups within G Corporation to begin seeing him as a threat. In order to deal with him, these executives attempted and failed to kill Kazuya in an explosion at the main Mishima Estate. Knowing Kazuya would seek revenge due to their betrayal, and that she was likely to be caught in his path and killed as well, Emma entrusted to Niklas a journal with instructions to secure what remained of her research on the Devil Gene.

Emma had planned for a message to automatically be sent to Leo on the eve of her death, stating in the letter that if Leo wished to know the truth, they would need to recover the data stored in G Corporation's Institute for the Study of Prehistoric Civilizations. Upon infiltrating, Leo reunited with Niklas, the two of them successful in retrieving Emma's data. What remained of Emma's research was then shared with Yggdrasil forces in order to be used to help stop Kazuya's continued path of destruction.
